policy: Only publish individual support programmes after checking the original official publisher page. Portal/catalogue records are discovery sources, not proof of eligibility or an open application.

sources.access: Official federal assistance listings; public API/data files described by SAM.gov

sources.name: UK Research and Innovation – Funding Finder
sources.coverage: United Kingdom; research, innovation and business funding
sources.access: Official RSS feed at https://www.ukri.org/opportunity/feed/
sources.notes: The RSS feed is a discovery stream and may not include every opportunity or deadline. Each opportunity must be checked on its official page; all imported records remain unverified.

sources.name: GrantConnect – Australian Government grants
sources.coverage: Australia; Commonwealth grant opportunities, forecasts and awards
sources.access: Official public RSS feed
sources.notes: Adapter collects official RSS notices from GrantConnect. Every candidate remains unverified until the original notice confirms current status, deadline and eligibility.

sources.name: Australian Research Council Grants Data Portal
sources.coverage: Australia; ARC research grants and awards
sources.access: Official JSON:API; paginated grants endpoint
sources.notes: Automated adapter imports research-grant records only. This is not a complete register of all Australian grants, personal benefits or currently open calls. Every record remains unverified.

sources.name: Government of Canada – Grants and funding
sources.coverage: Canada; agriculture, business, culture, education, health, jobs, research and social support
sources.access: Official searchable government directory; no public structured API confirmed
sources.notes: National starting point for federal grants and funding. Individual programmes may be administered through separate departmental portals.

sources.name: Funding Explorer
sources.coverage: New Zealand; government funding options for businesses across sectors
sources.access: Official government finder; public API/feed not confirmed
sources.notes: Government-wide business funding finder. Confirm current availability and eligibility with the administering agency.

sources.name: MBIE – Open and upcoming science and innovation funding
sources.publisher: New Zealand Ministry of Business, Innovation and Employment
sources.coverage: New Zealand; research, science and innovation funding
sources.access: Official programme listings; public structured feed/API not confirmed
sources.notes: Official list of open and upcoming science and innovation funding rounds. Dates and eligibility must be checked on each programme page.

sources.name: Canadian Institutes of Health Research – Funding opportunities
sources.coverage: Canada; health research, scholarships, fellowships and training
sources.access: Official ResearchNet RSS feed
sources.notes: RSS candidates are collected automatically. These are health research opportunities, not a complete list of Canadian public benefits or all grants; each notice remains unverified.
